sql: WITH race_laps AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS race_name, r.year, c.location AS circuit_location, MAX(res.laps) AS laps FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name, r.year, c.location) SELECT race_name, year, circuit_location, laps FROM race_laps WHERE laps = (SELECT MAX(laps) FROM race_laps);
